form.modeWorkday: Evening bake after work (in the fridge during the day)

recap.fridgeHours: The dough will spend about {{hours}} hours in the fridge.

workday.autolyseDesc: Mix flours: [{{flours}}] and {{water}}g of lukewarm water. Cover the bowl.
workday.fridgeDesc: Work in {{yeast}}g of yeast and salt. Put the bowl straight into the fridge (4 °C) and head to work!
workday.bathDesc: Take the dough out of the fridge. Submerge the bowl in lukewarm water (30-32 °C) to warm it up after the whole day.
workday.mixDesc: Knead the dough thoroughly ({{hydration}}% hydration). With {{protein}}g of protein the dough is beautifully elastic.
workday.foldDesc: A series of 4 folds from the sides to strengthen the gluten network.
workday.shapeDesc: Shape the loaf and place it in the banneton (~{{mins}} min proofing at {{temp}}°C).
workday.preheatDesc: Preheat the oven with the pot at full power.
workday.bakeDesc: 20 min at 230 °C covered, then 20 min at 200 °C uncovered.
workday.doneDesc: Take the bread out and let it cool completely on a rack.

overnight.fridgeDesc: Add {{yeast}}g of yeast and salt. Put the dough in the fridge overnight (4 °C).
overnight.bathDesc: Warm the dough from the fridge in a lukewarm water bath.
overnight.mixDesc: Knead the dough and prepare it for folding.
overnight.shapeDesc: Proofing in the banneton ~{{mins}} min at {{temp}}°C.
overnight.preheatDesc: Preheat the oven with the cast iron pot.
overnight.bakeDesc: 20 min at 230 °C covered, then 20 min at 200 °C uncovered.
overnight.doneDesc: Let the bread cool on a rack.
